positions.title: Engineering Teacher
positions.description: I lead 8 sections of classes called Principles of Engineering. I plan and execute lessons that focus on various engineering topics to give students a broad overview of engineering principles. I integrate critical thinking and the design process to push students to the point where they can problem solve issues that they have never faced before. I collaborate with another teacher who alters my materials for their same class, as well as with a learning specialist to make accommodations and differentiate so all my students can access the content.

positions.title: Academic Tutor
positions.description:
Lead one-on-one sessions for students in Calculus I, II, III and Differential Equations
Brainstorm various ways to help students reach a better understanding of the material

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
Synthesizing solid acid catalysts, characterizing them through esterification 
reactions and testing their interactions with biomass, specifically glucose.

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description: Excel modeling, market research, coordinating group calls and meetings, presentations to management

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Worked in UW-Madison’s department of Chemical and Biological Engineering
to study the role played by certain catalysts in the aqueous-phase breakdown of cellulose
Participated in a poster session at the end of the summer

Organized patron seating and problem-solved with co-workers to ensure customer 
satisfaction
